description: Config file cases both SDKs must read identically: tests/config.test.ts (TypeScript) and tests/test_sdk_config_shared.py (Python). 'expected' lists every config field in snake_case after defaults; 'error' is a regular expression the error message matches. 'env' is the whole environment the file is read with.

valid.name: default_profile selects the profile; values keep their TOML types
valid.toml:
default_profile = "lab"

[profiles.default]
base_url = "http://default.local"
api_token = "default-token"

[profiles.lab]
base_url = "http://lab.local/"
api_token = "lab-token"
project_id = "lab"
timeout_sec = 9
verify_tls = false
read_attempts = 2
proxy = "http://proxy.local:3128"

valid.name: an explicit profile wins over default_profile
api_token_env reads the selected profile's variable only
empty strings mean unset
valid.toml:
[profiles.default]
base_url = "http://d.local"
api_token = "t"
project_id = ""
proxy = ""
cf_access_client_id = "cid"
cf_access_client_secret = "csecret"
user_agent = "probe/1"
